A map marks the Bloodsail Buccaneers’ intended camp in Booty Bay with a red X. Their orders call for silence. The crew must kill anyone who approaches and wait for a signal from the southern command post before attacking. You carry the findings back to First Mate Crazz in Booty Bay. He sent you to scout, and the pirates are still waiting for the signal before they attack.

quest:598.text: Split Bone Necklace. Kin'weelay at Grom'gol Base Camp sends you southeast to hunt the Skullsplitters. The Darkspears left Stranglethorn Vale, yet their old feud with these jungle rivals continues. Bring back twenty-five split bone trophies to aid the Darkspears and earn their friendship. After the Bloodscalp hunt, Kin'weelay turns to another old enemy. Southeast of Grom'gol Base Camp, the Skullsplitter tribe has fought the Darkspears for many years. The Darkspears no longer live in Stranglethorn Vale, yet they remain bound to this war. You travel into Skullsplitter territory to claim twenty-five split bone necklaces and earn the Darkspears' friendship and respect. Kin'weelay takes pride in seeing these hostile trolls cut down like young saplings by a basilisk. Each trophy you bring back counts as a victory for his people.

quest:599.text: The Bloodsail Buccaneers. First Mate Crazz has learned that the Bloodsail Buccaneers mean to strike Booty Bay. He sends you to warn Fleet Master Seahorn, commander of the Blackwater Raiders, before they move. First Mate Crazz sends you to warn Fleet Master Seahorn of an attack on Booty Bay. Crazz has learned the Bloodsail Buccaneers mean to strike the port directly, and the threat is greater than he first thought. Seahorn is somewhere in town. He must hear the warning before the rival pirates move.

quest:600.text: Venture Company Mining. In northern Stranglethorn, the Venture Company keeps finding Singing Blue Crystals. Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay wants ten brought back from the hills near Crystalvein Mine. You’ve gathered Singing Blue Shards, and now Crank Fizzlebub points you toward a larger rival. The Venture Company’s work across the jungle cuts into the profits of independent goblins. Basilisks keep its miners out of Crystalvein Mine, so they dig in the hills around it for Singing Blue Crystals. Crank asks you to take ten from the miners and bring them to Booty Bay as proof of their setback.

quest:601.text: Water Elementals. On the island off the coast, Water Elementals may offer a clue to the Stone of the Tides' curse. Baron Revilgaz wants their bracers examined for a way to counter it. Baron Revilgaz suspects the Water Elementals' magical residue may help fight the Stone of the Tides' curse. The stone is said to make anyone who wields it drift in and out of reality. So he sends you back to the island off the coast to gather bracers for the scholarly mages of Dalaran to examine. Baron Revilgaz admits he lacks the skill to judge whether the bracers can help. He refuses to leave Booty Bay just to speak with tiresome old mages. So he sends you north to have a mage examine them.

quest:602.text: Magical Analysis. From Booty Bay, Baron Revilgaz sends you north to Dalaran with water elemental bracers. He hopes Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver can study the curse tied to the Stone of the Tides. Baron Revilgaz has the bracers in Booty Bay, but their secret lies beyond his reach. The town has no mage skilled enough to unravel the curse behind the Stone of the Tides, so he points you toward Dalaran. Its wizards are working to rebuild their broken kingdom. Revilgaz has dealt with Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver before and trusts his knowledge. He believes no mage can resist an intriguing puzzle.

quest:6027.text: Book of the Ancients. At the Ethel Rethor tower, Azore Aldamort entrusts you with the Gem of the Serpent. Set it on the Serpent Statue on Ranazjar Isle, northwest of the tower, and the guardian of the Book of the Ancients will appear. After Sceptre of Light, Azore Aldamort gives you the Gem of the Serpent. Ranazjar Isle lies northwest of the Ethel Rethor tower, and there the Serpent Statue waits. Set the gem on its hand to call forth the Book of the Ancients’ guardian. The naga have kept the book’s secrets for centuries, and Azore hopes it will teach much about their scaled foes.

quest:603.text: Ansirem's Key. An ancient troll dagger may weaken the magic empowering the Stone of the Tides. Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver found the blade in Stranglethorn, then gave it to his daughter Catelyn, who left home for the pirates of Booty Bay. Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver has found that an altar, or focal point, amplifies the Stone of the Tides. To overpower that magic, he needs an ancient troll dagger he uncovered while researching in Stranglethorn. He gave the blade to his daughter Catelyn long ago. Headstrong, she left home for the pirates of Booty Bay.

quest:604.text: The Bloodsail Buccaneers. On the Wild Shore, the Bloodsail Buccaneers have raised a southern command post. Fleet Master Seahorn sends a trusted Blackwater Raider to seize their charts and orders, so the fleet can learn their plans. Crazz’s praise has brought you to Fleet Master Seahorn’s notice. The Bloodsail Buccaneers have raised a southern command post on the Wild Shore. Seahorn sends you to strike their camp, cut down their swashbucklers, and seize their naval charts and written orders. The fleet needs those papers to learn what its rivals intend.

quest:605.text: Singing Blue Shards. In Stranglethorn Vale, buyers seek Singing Blue Shards. The Venture Company makes it hard for Crank Fizzlebub to gather raw Singing Crystals, so he offers you a cut of the profits for ten shards taken from basilisk hides. Crank Fizzlebub has buyers for Singing Crystals, found only in Stranglethorn Vale. The Venture Company makes gathering raw crystals hard for him. So he seeks another way to get them. Basilisks eat the crystals, and the mineral becomes part of their hardened hides. You can recover usable shards there. Basilisks across the jungle may yield crystal fragments. Fizzlebub points you to the gentler ones along the northern shores south of Zul'Kunda. Bring him ten shards so he can move ahead with his buyers. Then his attention turns to the Venture Company's operations.

quest:606.text: Scaring Shaky. At Booty Bay's docks, “Shaky” Phillipe still owes “Sea Wolf” MacKinley from last week's game. MacKinley sends you outside town for Elder Mistvale Gorilla giblets to frighten Phillipe into paying. “Sea Wolf” MacKinley wants his gambling debts paid, and many people owe him. “Shaky” Phillipe is first. He waits by the docks in Booty Bay and owes a large sum from last week's game. MacKinley sends you outside town to hunt Elder Mistvale Gorillas and bring back plenty of giblets. Keep their animal origin quiet, so Phillipe imagines the worst.

quest:607.text: Return to MacKinley. You carry Phillipe’s pouch to Sea Wolf MacKinley, who is owed payment. Phillipe says he meant to pay all along and asks that you go easy. "Shaky" Phillipe hands you a pouch of payment for Sea Wolf MacKinley. He swears he always meant to repay the debt. Phillipe says he got a little drunk and lost the way. He thinks MacKinley will understand, and insists there is no need to get rough.

quest:608.text: The Bloodsail Buccaneers. In Stranglethorn, the Bloodsail Buccaneers gather strength for an attack. Fleet Master Seahorn will not risk his whole fleet in a counterstrike, so he sends a small crew against their leaders before they can begin. Fleet Master Seahorn means to halt the Bloodsail attack before it gains strength. He mocks Fleet Master Firallon's skill at sea, then chooses to strike at the commanders. Seahorn will not risk a full naval battle. Instead, he sends a small crew to Firallon's landing camp to kill Firallon, Captain Stillwater, and Captain Keelhaul. Without their leaders, the buccaneers will be left without command.

quest:609.text: Voodoo Dues. In Booty Bay, “Sea Wolf” MacKinley is still waiting for three old debts to be paid. Maury “Club Foot” Wilkins, Jon-Jon the Crow, and Chucky “Ten Thumbs” owe him, but rumors say curses and enchantment sent them wandering ancient jungle ruins. MacKinley wants their prized possessions, whatever their fate. You have already collected debts for “Sea Wolf” MacKinley, but three accounts remain unpaid. Maury “Club Foot” Wilkins, Jon-Jon the Crow, and Chucky “Ten Thumbs” have owed him for months. MacKinley first thought they had left Booty Bay to escape their debts. Then he heard they had met a stranger, darker fate deep in the jungle. Whispers say curses and enchantment have left the three men wandering ancient stonework northeast of Booty Bay. They are said to roam the Ruins of Aboraz and the Ruins of Jubuwal. MacKinley wants you to find each man and take his notable valuables: Jon-Jon's Golden Spyglass, Chucky's Huge Ring, and Maury's Clubbed Foot.

quest:610.text: "Pretty Boy" Duncan. Catelyn the Blade has lost the dagger her father asked her to return. She wants it back from Pretty Boy Duncan before she helps you further. Catelyn the Blade has left the mages and their dusty tomes behind. Ansirem's Key led you to her, but she cannot give you the dagger her father asked her to return. A Bloodsail Buccaneer took it. Until her blade is recovered, Catelyn will hand over nothing else. Pretty Boy Duncan struck Catelyn unconscious and took the knife she carried in a fight. She relies on that weapon. Now she insists on getting that very blade back from the buccaneer before she helps you further.

quest:611.text: The Curse of the Tides. Off Stranglethorn's coast, Catelyn the Blade lends you her recovered knife to strike a sunken altar. Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay seeks the Stone of the Tides for his collection of ancient troll artifacts. Catelyn the Blade lends you her recovered troll dagger to break an altar beneath the waves. She knows less of troll ruins than her father, but has heard of a sunken troll city. So she points you northwest of Grom'gol Base Camp. There, in the Vile Reef's underwater ruins, the Altar of the Tides glows blue among sea life and murlocs.

quest:613.text: Cracking Maury's Foot. At Booty Bay, MacKinley still cannot claim what Maury owed him. Maury locked the debt inside his own foot, so MacKinley sends travelers to the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound in Stranglethorn Vale to find the key. After the foot was recovered in Voodoo Dues, "Sea Wolf" MacKinley faces another obstacle in Booty Bay. His late debtor locked the foot, sealing the valuables he owes inside. Maury gambled with the ogres at the Mosh'Ogg mound northeast of Booty Bay. MacKinley recalls Maury saying they drove him away after he won too much. So MacKinley suspects they have the key and sends you to search for it.

quest:6132.text: Get Me Out of Here!. In the Valley of Spears, Melizza Brimbuzzle fears the Maraudines mean to eat her. She asks you to get her out, and her brother Hornizz promises good pay. Melizza Brimbuzzle came to the Valley of Spears hoping to strike a deal with the Maraudines. They would not talk, and now she fears they mean to eat her. Minutes ago, she overheard centaurs discussing wood for their cookpot. She wants to leave quickly. Hornizz Brimbuzzle waits at the family camp east of Melizza's present position. It lies beside the kodo graveyard. Melizza promises her brother will pay you well if you bring her out of the valley.

quest:6134.text: Ghost-o-plasm Round Up. Hornizz Brimbuzzle sends you into the Valley of Bones for ghost energy, hoping the Magram will pay well for it. Hornizz Brimbuzzle sends you southeast to the Valley of Bones, where Magram ghosts walk. The valley sounds frightening to him. Yet he thinks the spirits must frighten the Magram even more, and he is sure the centaurs would pay well for ghost energy captured there. Hornizz Brimbuzzle gives you a crate of ghost magnets. Set one between the two huge skeletons called the Dead Goliaths, and it draws the ghosts toward it. The spirits yield ghost-o-plasm, which Hornizz plans to sell to the Magram. He asks you to bring him eight ghost-o-plasms and the crate.

quest:6141.text: Brother Anton. In Nijel's Point, Brother Anton seeks help against the undead in Desolace. He came from distant lands after hearing of the threat. Rumors of undead in Desolace reached Brother Anton in far-off Kalimdor. He booked passage at once to seek them out and destroy them. Now he looks for people with courage and resolve. If your heart is true, Brother Crowley sends you to find him in Nijel's Point, the Alliance town in Desolace.

quest:6142.text: Clam Bait. At Shadowprey Village, Mai'Lahii trusts one bait above all others. He asks for ten pieces of soft-shelled clam meat from the wrecked ship north along the coast. Mai'Lahii asks you for bait fish cannot resist. He has fished all his life and trusts soft-shelled clam meat above all else. North of Shadowprey Village, a wrecked ship lies off the coast, and soft-shelled clams are scattered throughout the area. He wants ten pieces of the meat.

quest:6143.text: Other Fish to Fry. At Shadowprey Village, Drulzegar Skraghook asks you to strike back at the Slitherblade. Naga took the fishing crew near Ranazjar Isle, and Drulzegar alone returned. Drulzegar Skraghook and the crew often fished near Ranazjar Isle. The isle lies north of a wreck on the coast. One morning, the naga attacked and killed everyone but Drulzegar. Now revenge fills Drulzegar's thoughts, and guilt is too much to bear. Drulzegar asks you to slay seven Slitherblade Myrmidons, seven Slitherblade Naga and five Slitherblade Sorceresses. A bad knee keeps Drulzegar from joining you. The naga usually lurk far down among coral reefs beneath the waves, Drulzegar says. Your effort will be rewarded.

quest:616.text: The Haunted Isle. In Booty Bay, Krazek hears a tale of an isle haunted by a goblin ghost. He gathers unusual rumors for Baron Revilgaz, and this one recalls an old troll legend. Krazek gathers reports of strange happenings throughout Stranglethorn Vale for Baron Revilgaz. In a Booty Bay tavern, sailors tell him of an isle off the coast where water elementals dwell. They say the ghost of a raving goblin haunts it. Krazek gives little heed to spectral gossip, but this tale catches his attention. He asks you to carry it to the baron. Baron Revilgaz remembers an old troll legend from a book when he hears Krazek's report. The water elementals and goblin apparition make him suspect that the Stone of the Tides may be within his grasp. He hopes to add the ancient relic to his personal collection of artifacts.

quest:6161.text: Claim Rackmore's Treasure!. During Claim Rackmore's Treasure!, Rackmore's log tells of a ship attacked on its way to Feathermoon Stronghold. He hid his treasure chest on Ranazjar Isle to keep it from his enemies, but both keys to open it were lost. Rackmore's log tells of seafaring creatures attacking his ship on its way to Feathermoon Stronghold. He hid his treasure chest on Ranazjar Isle to keep it from his enemies. Both keys needed to open it were lost, one silver and one gold. Whoever finds the keys and the chest will find a treasure.

quest:617.text: Akiris by the Bundle. In Booty Bay, Privateer Bloads seeks akiris reeds for an associate who pays well. The naga were last seen on the northern beach, where you must take the reeds from them. Privateer Bloads offers seaside work in Booty Bay. His associate Groy pays well for bundles of akiris reed, a plant that grows by the sea and bears the name the naga give it. Bloads does not know why Groy wants the reeds. He needs ten stalks, and the naga were last seen on the northern beach.

quest:618.text: Facing Negolash. Along Stranglethorn Vale's coast, a stolen cutlass sets events in motion. Sprogger knows how to draw Negolash out with the giant's favorite food and drink. When giants wrecked Captain Smotts' vessel, Negolash headed for the galley. He left the crew alone and went after wine and Barbecued Buzzard Wings, Sprogger's specialty. Sprogger had traveled to the Badlands to learn the recipe. Sprogger plans to lure Negolash with a feast. You carry ten servings of wings and five bottles of wine to Captain Smotts' ruined lifeboat on the southeastern shore. The banquet draws the giant near. Then you can confront him and reclaim the captain's cutlass.

quest:619.text: Enticing Negolash. Along Stranglethorn Vale's shore, a marked lifeboat offers a way to lure Negolash. Ten barbecued buzzard wings and five bottles of junglevine wine lie on the wreck. The abandoned lifeboat bears the faded words Smotts' Revenge. While hunting Negolash, arrange ten barbecued buzzard wings and five bottles of junglevine wine on the wreck to draw him out.

quest:621.text: Zanzil's Secret. Crank Fizzlebub seeks Zanzil's Secret in the ruins northeast of Booty Bay. The exiled troll's brew bends minds and strengthens bodies, and Crank wants samples for himself. Northeast of Booty Bay, Zanzil has made his home in the ruins of Jubuwal and Aboraz. His former tribal leaders cast him out, fearing his mastery over other minds. Now he rules followers with concoctions made from jungle plants. The mixtures dull their will and heighten their strength, leaving them docile but sturdy. Crank Fizzlebub sees profit in Zanzil's craft. Those who want power over others might pay handsomely for such a brew, so the goblin wants a supply from the ruins. Deliver enough samples and Crank offers the usual coin, with a quiet bonus if you keep the bargain private.

quest:622.text: Return to Corporal Kaleb. At the Rebel Camp, Corporal Kaleb waits for the pot Krazek repaired in Booty Bay. It has a second steam whistle and a chopper built into its base. Krazek has finished repairing the pot you brought him. He added another steam whistle and fitted a chopper to its base, sharp enough to cut through leg bones. He calls it a sure way to please the cook and expects its owner to be glad of the changes. Now it is ready to return to Corporal Kaleb at the Rebel Camp.

quest:623.text: Akiris by the Bundle. In Stranglethorn Vale, Bloads has a fresh bundle of akiris reeds bound for Theramore Isle. His contact, Privateer Groy, has a client eager for more, but Bloads cannot sail to Dustwallow Marsh for another week. While you are away, word reaches you from across the sea. Privateer Groy in Theramore Isle is pleased with the last shipment of akiris reeds, and a client wants another bundle at once. Privateer Bloads cannot sail to Dustwallow Marsh for another week. So he gives you the parcel to carry across the sea by hand.

quest:624.text: Cortello's Riddle. A parchment bearing Cortello's Riddle turns up aboard Bloodsail Buccaneer vessels along the Wild Shore. Its verse sends you toward a clue beneath an ornate bridge. Bloodsail Buccaneers anchored off Stranglethorn Vale's southern coast carry scattered notes with a rhyme. Cortello's verse describes a finely worked bridge, worn by many travelers. It lies east of Deadwind and south of Redridge. Follow the directions out of the jungle and into the marshes, where something waits below.

quest:625.text: Cortello's Riddle. Travelers follow Cortello's second verse across the sea to Kalimdor. Its lines point treasure hunters toward a cave in southwestern Dustwallow Marsh. Cortello's second verse sends searchers toward Kalimdor. It describes Dustwallow Marsh, a gloomy wetland east of the Barrens. The riddle points to a clue in a cave in the southwest of the marsh.

quest:626.text: Cortello's Riddle. In the Hinterlands, the final verses of Cortello's Riddle draw treasure hunters to the coast. A musty scroll points north from the southern tropics, and the trail ends beneath the waterfalls. The weathered verse turns the search north, away from the southern tropics and toward Lordaeron. There, amid the great turmoil of the embattled lands, the long chase reaches its end along the coast. The final hoard lies along the Hinterlands shore. Search underwater at the foot of the great falls.

quest:627.text: Favor for Krazek. In Booty Bay, Krazek pauses his work on a broken crock pot to ask you for four loads of lesser bloodstone ore from the northern hills. He will return the cookware when you bring them. Krazek pauses his repair of the broken cookware in Booty Bay to offer a trade. He sends you far north to the Arathi Highlands. There, a cave in Drywhisker Gorge holds lesser bloodstone ore. The mineral is low grade, yet those who know its uses prize it. Krazek keeps working on the pot while you travel north. He expects four loads of bloodstone and promises payment if you bring back enough. The ore must be mined. If you lack the skill, you need someone who can extract it.

quest:628.text:
Excelsior. In Booty Bay, Drizzlik is ready for the last piece of the Excelsior boots. He needs an elder saltwater crocolisk skin for their outer layer. Drizzlik has finished the boots’ inner layer. For the outside, he uses the finest elder crocolisk skins. They are tougher and give the Excelsior designs and accents a better surface. Only an elder saltwater crocolisk skin fits his plan.

Finding one is difficult. Elders come out only to guard other saltwater crocolisks. Drizzlik has also read that saltwater crocolisk numbers are dwindling, which worries him for his business.

quest:629.text:
The Vile Reef. Beneath the Savage Coast, Kin'weelay seeks a shard from the sunken troll city. He hopes to carry Gri'lek's story to Orgrimmar, where the Darkspear can preserve it. Northwest of Grom'gol Base Camp, the Savage Coast hides an ancient troll city beneath the water. A violent earthquake shattered the land long ago and sank the city. Now called the Vile Reef, its flooded ruins are home to hostile murlocs who attack anyone who ventures near.

On the sea floor rests a massive stone tablet carved with the story of Gri'lek. He was a legendary troll hero, and the Darkspear still hold his memory sacred. The monument is too massive to carry from the depths, so Kin'weelay asks you to break off a shard. He plans to take the fragment to Orgrimmar and enshrine it in a sacred place. There, the Darkspear can keep Gri'lek's strength and honor in their memory.

quest:630.text: Message in a Bottle. The message in a bottle brings you to an island off the Stranglethorn coast, where Princess Poobah waits in chains. King Mukla commands the island’s beasts and keeps her captive. To free her, you need the key to her shackle. On an island off the Stranglethorn coast, Princess Poobah waits in chains. The message in the bottle has brought you to her. King Mukla is a great Skymane gorilla who commands the creatures roaming the island. He keeps Poobah imprisoned, and she trusts you to face the ape and bring back her shackle key. Princess Poobah says her captor often prowls the island’s southeastern side. King Mukla is a formidable foe. Defeating him is the only way to claim the shackle key and free Poobah.

quest:635.text: Crystal in the Mountains. In Arathi's northern mountains, a vision draws you toward a gleaming crystal. The Pendant of Myzrael pulses in your hand as a plea for help reaches you. The Pendant of Myzrael pulses in your hand, carrying a plea from someone in need of help. Then a vision shows a gleaming crystal thrusting from the ground in the mountains north of Arathi. You feel drawn there.

quest:638.text: Trollbane. At Hammerfall, the Darkspear prepare for battles against Zul'Gurub's jungle trolls. Vol'jin has sent them to recover Trol'kalar from ruined Stromgarde, where the blade rested in human hands. After King Thoras Trollbane fell, Stromgarde became a ruin. Chieftain Vol'jin then ordered the Darkspear to spirit Trol'kalar away. The storied sword had long rested in human hands. Now the tribe seeks it for the battles ahead against Zul'Gurub's jungle trolls. Vol'jin sent Zengu, a seasoned hunter, to Hammerfall in the northeastern Arathi Highlands. From Stranglethorn Vale, Nimboya directs travelers to find Zengu and help secure the legendary sword.

quest:639.text: Sigil of Strom. At Hammerfall, Zengu seeks the sigils that guard Trol'kalar, Lord Ignaeus Trollbane's sword. The Syndicate took the Sigil of Strom, and one of its agents in Stromgarde likely carries it. Long ago, Lord Ignaeus of Strom, called Trollbane, was the Arathorian Empire's ablest foe in its war against the trolls. He wielded Trol'kalar in battle. In the trolls' old tongue, its name means troll slayer. Now Trollbane's sons are weakened, and their stronghold lies in ruins. Several sigils guard Trol'kalar, and Stromgarde's survivors each took some. Zengu says they must all be recovered. The Syndicate seized the first, the Sigil of Strom. Zengu believes one of its agents in Stromgarde holds it. Bring the sigil back to Zengu at Hammerfall.

quest:640.text: The Broken Sigil. Zengu sends you to recover sigils from the Stromgarde militia. Galen, son of Thoras Trollbane, broke the Sigil of Thoradin into eleven pieces, and you carry them to Tor'gan in Hammerfall. Three sigils guard Thoras Trollbane's tomb. You have taken the first from the Syndicate. The firmly entrenched Stromgarde militia holds the other two. Galen, Thoras' son, broke the Sigil of Thoradin into eleven pieces and scattered them among the defenders. Zengu asks you to gather the pieces from Stromgarde's defenders. Then carry them to Tor'gan, the troll shaman at Hammerfall. He can bind them into a whole sigil.

quest:641.text: Sigil of Thoradin. Tor'gan has restored the Sigil of Thoradin, and Zengu waits in Hammerfall for its return. The sigil can open the seal on Trollbane's tomb. Tor'gan's reconstruction has worked. The Sigil of Thoradin can open the seal on Trollbane's tomb, so he sends you back to Zengu in Hammerfall. Zengu has more for you to do.

quest:642.text: The Princess Trapped. Across the Arathi Highlands, an iridescent shard carries Myzrael’s plea from deep underground. She calls herself a princess of the earth, imprisoned by giants, and asks travelers to strengthen a crystal cluster in Drywhisker Gorge. Strange shards lie scattered across the Arathi Highlands, humming with distant power. Near them, Myzrael’s voice rises from deep beneath the ground. She calls herself a princess of the earth, cast down and bound underground by ancient giants. Cut off from the lands above, she uses the crystals to carry her plea to anyone willing to listen. Myzrael directs you east to Drywhisker Gorge, where she asks you to strengthen your contact with her. Drywhisker kobolds infest the gorge, and she calls them allies of the giants who hold her captive. They carry Motes of Myzrael and guard a cluster of iridescent shards. Take the motes from the kobolds and use their energy on the formation. That will strengthen the crystal cluster and deepen your communication with the trapped princess.

quest:643.text: Sigil of Arathor. Zengu sends you from Hammerfall to seek a sigil carried by human cavalry in the Arathi Highlands. Find their leader, Lieutenant Valorcall, and bring the sigil back. Zengu doubts the humans can claim Stromgarde, much less the whole Arathi Highlands. Yet their prince still sends the last of his horsemen through the countryside. Zengu cannot see why. He knows Lieutenant Valorcall leads those riders and carries one of the sigils. Find Valorcall and bring it back to Hammerfall.

quest:644.text: Sigil of Trollbane. In Hammerfall, Zengu sends you deep into Stromgarde for the Sigil of Trollbane. Prince Galen keeps the last sigil, which is needed to claim Trol'kalar. Prince Galen, son of Thoras Trollbane, keeps the last sigil in Stromgarde. He waits in a chapel deep in the districts held by the militia. Zengu warns that Galen is well guarded and a fine fighter. You are to kill the prince and carry the sigil back to Zengu in Hammerfall.

quest:645.text: Trol'kalar. At Stromgarde, Zengu sends you after Trol'kalar, now that four sigils have joined as one. Zengu has seen the four sigils unite as the Sigil of Ignaeus. He believes their union can break the wardings on Trollbane's tomb. The tomb lies in the Sanctum behind Stromgarde's chapel, and Zengu sends you there to retrieve Trol'kalar. A fenced path to the right of the chapel entrance descends to the crypt.

quest:646.text: Trol'kalar. At Trollbane's Tomb, Trol'kalar slips free of its stone sheath as the light fades. You carry the sword to Zengu in Hammerfall. At Trollbane's Tomb, you find Trol'kalar free of its stone sheath. You carry the sheathed sword to Zengu in Hammerfall, in the Arathi Highlands.

quest:648.text: Rescue OOX-17/TN!. At Steamwheedle Port, OOX-17/TN needs time and open ground for take-off. Oglethorpe's voice comes through the damaged robot, asking you to escort it there safely, then find him in Booty Bay. Oglethorpe's voice crackles through OOX-17/TN again. The robot has built-in cloaking, but Oglethorpe needs time to make it work again. It needs an open, safe place to begin its lengthy take-off. Oglethorpe has chosen Steamwheedle Port, and the journey there will give him time to restore the cloaking. You are asked to escort the robot safely. Once OOX-17/TN reaches Steamwheedle Port, find Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay. He is a master inventor.

quest:651.text: Stones of Binding. In Arathi, four Stones of Binding hold Myzrael beneath the ground. A voice from the iridescent shards says the strongest stone needs keys from the other three. Across Arathi, four stones keep Myzrael beneath the ground, a voice says. The Stone of Inner Binding is strongest, and keys from the Stones of West, East and Outer Binding can unlock it. Gather the Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key. Guardians watch the stones, though someone clever or lucky may find a way to banish them. Carry the keys to the Stone of Inner Binding.

quest:652.text: Breaking the Keystone. The voice has more freedom now, though the Keystone still binds it. The Keystone lies among a ring of stones, and Fozruk holds the key the watchers call the Rod of Order. Opening the Stones of Binding eased the voice's confinement, but one lock still holds the Keystone. It lies among the circle of stones around you. Fozruk, a stone watcher and one of its captors, holds the key the watchers call the Rod of Order. Carry the rod to the Keystone and open the lock. The voice promises gratitude that will shake the earth to its roots. Geomantic energy fills the Keystone.

quest:653.text: Myzrael's Allies. Myzrael is free, yet she must gather strength before she can face her captors. She calls you a noble ally and sends you to Gerrig Bonegrip in a shop in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern, where he knows how to summon her. Myzrael is free, but not strong enough to face her captors. They would overpower her now and lock her away again. So she will gather strength in hiding. When she is ready, she means to face the giants and make them rue the day they held her. She calls you a noble ally and says she will need your help to summon her to the surface. Myzrael sends you to Gerrig Bonegrip, whose shop is in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern. He knows how to summon her.

quest:654.text:
Tanaris Field Sampling. In Tanaris, a field test begins as soon as the kit's power source is switched on. Your two hours of sampling start then. Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle expected the kit to glow and vibrate once its power source was running. Now you have two hours to gather acceptable samples from eight basilisks, eight hyenas and eight scorpions in the Tanaris desert.

If the time runs out, all the data is lost. You will need to buy another power source from Bilgewhizzle, then return the kit to him in Gadgetzan before its power gives out. Bilgewhizzle offers no sympathy when a kit goes dead. The Gadgetzan Water Company’s profit is all that matters to him.

He will keep selling power sources until the company can afford to import water from the icy springs of Dun Morogh.

quest:655.text: Hammerfall. At Hammerfall, the Horde holds a camp won at the cost of Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer's life. Gor'mul remembers the captives' escape and why the stronghold bears its name. In the Arathi Highlands, the Alliance once held orcs captive behind wood and steel. Young Thrall and Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer led an assault on the camp's enclosures and freed their kin. Many captives escaped as the defenses fell. Then a mounted lance struck Doomhammer from behind. He died where Hammerfall now stands. Gor'mul was among those who did not find freedom that day. In the battle's chaos and the earth's tremors, he watched the Warchief fall and lost the will to fight. His brethren fled, leaving him behind. For years, Gor'mul wandered the highlands in grief. The Horde has reclaimed the site as a fortified base, yet survivors still carry the memory of Doomhammer's death.

quest:656.text: Summoning the Princess. At the Shards of Myzrael, you summon Myzrael and face her before she grows strong enough to challenge her captors. Theldurin the Lost wants her defeated and her Eldritch Shackles bound to the Shards. Theldurin fears Myzrael will grow strong enough to turn against her captors. Some say she can be controlled. But Theldurin asks why the giants would have chained her if that were true. You take the Scroll of Myzrael to the Shards, where you first spoke with her, and call her forth. Once Myzrael is defeated, you bind her Eldritch Shackles to the Shards and trap her again.

quest:6568.text: The Testament of Rexxar. Rexxar sends you to the Western Plaguelands with a message for Myranda the Hag. He needs her skill with illusions to pass the Black Flight's defenses. Rexxar needs an illusion to pass the Black Flight's defenses. So he sends you to Myranda the Hag, a master illusionist who lives in the Western Plaguelands. The Lordaeron alliance drove her out. She has helped Rexxar's kind before, when a cause seemed worthy. Now you carry his message to her. A member of the Horde is a rare sight in these parts of Lordaeron, Myranda says. Then she asks what you have brought her.

quest:657.text: Hints of a New Plague?. Kinelory is bound for Go'Shek Farm, where Apothecary Jorell's deadly experiments continue. Quae has learned of them from a folder, but she is too hurt from a clash with orcs to go along. The folder shows that Jorell is conducting deadly experiments at Go'Shek Farm. Quae does not know what they mean for Hillsbrad. But Phin would not want them to continue. Some of Jorell's research has already reached Tarren Mill. Quae fought some orcs while you were away, and now she cannot help Kinelory. Kinelory plans to go to the farm and take the research Jorell has not yet sent to Tarren Mill. She needs your protection on the way.

quest:658.text:
Hints of a New Plague?. At Go'Shek Farm, Quae and Kin have watched for days, and Kin saw a courier leave a small house to the south. They suspect she carries notes to Tarren Mill, so Quae asks you to track her and bring back the documents. Quae expected Phin Odelic to send you. He worries too much, in Quae's view. Quae and Kin have watched the farm for days, and Kin recently saw a courier leave a small house to the south. Kin talks often, but Quae trusts Kin's senses in dangerous places. Quae asks if you are a skilled tracker. The courier may carry notes bound for Tarren Mill, and the documents could shed light on what is happening in Hillsbrad. Find the Forsaken Courier and bring her Sealed Folder to Quae near Go'Shek Farm.

While you search, Kin spots an apothecary leaving that same house. Quae suspects the apothecary is up to no good, but needs proof before anyone acts rashly.

quest:659.text: Hints of a New Plague?. In Hillsbrad, Phin Odelic's band searches for signs of trouble. Quae and Kinelory have been missing for days after traveling to Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands. Phin Odelic's cousin in Hillsbrad had to put down his dog, Stanley. The beast had mystically grown huge and attacked anyone who came near. Phin suspects the undead are behind these strange happenings. So his band searches for signs to prove it. Quae and Kinelory traveled to Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands. They have not checked in for days, and Phin fears for them. He asks you to find them near the farm.

quest:660.text: Hints of a New Plague?. Kinelory is ready to go down to the farm, and asks you to come with her. She fears the undead may harm Hillsbrad while they wait. You are needed to see her safely back. Kinelory is ready to act after the earlier steps of the investigation. She asks you to go with her down to the farm, then return safely to Quae. The people of Hillsbrad need her protected.

quest:661.text:
Hints of a New Plague?. In Arathi, Quae and Kinelory remain near the farm while you carry news to Southshore. Quae has the farm items, and Kinelory has returned safely. Quae is pleased with how you cared for Kinelory. She says Kinelory is in better shape than after a night at the tavern. The items from the farm should help Phin Odelic understand what is happening in Arathi.

Since the farm was attacked, Quae and Kinelory plan to stay there a little longer in case anyone retaliates. They ask you to return to Southshore and speak with Phin.

quest:662.text: Deep Sea Salvage. After Land Ho!, First Mate Nilzlix asks you to recover the charts and logs from two wrecks before anyone leaves the cove. O'Breen brought three ships into the cove, certain treasure lay there. The Harbinger docked safely. But the Maiden's Folly and the Spirit of Silverpine reached the reef as the tides began to fall. Both struck a temple-like structure and sank fast. First Mate Nilzlix wants you to recover the logs and charts from both wrecks. He fears the information could reach prying eyes. If enemies found it, Fleet Master Seahorn would force the crew down the plank.

quest:663.text:
Land Ho!. At Faldir's Cove, Lolo warns you that Captain O'Breen's brief stop may last far longer than planned. The Spirit of Silverpine and the Maiden's Folly are lost, and Lolo directs you to the captain. Lolo greets you at Faldir's Cove and tells you what has gone wrong. Captain O'Breen promised the crew only a few hours ashore to gather treasure before sailing back to Booty Bay. Lolo doubts they will be away so briefly.

The Spirit of Silverpine and the Maiden's Folly, two ships in the formation, now lie on the sea floor. If you mean to stay, Lolo says to speak with the captain.

quest:664.text: Drowned Sorrows. At Faldir's Cove, Captain Steelgut mourns the Maiden's Folly and asks you to kill the Daggerspine naga who slew the wreck's survivors. At Faldir's Cove, Captain Steelgut sits by the fire and wishes the sea had taken him too. His crew fought hard to save the Maiden's Folly, but water rushed in all at once and the ship sank. O'Breen reached shore safely, while the naga killed the other survivors. Steelgut wants ten Daggerspine raiders and three Daggerspine sorceresses dead.

quest:665.text: Sunken Treasure. Professor Phizzlethorpe and Doctor Draxlegauge now aid the Blackwater Raiders in their search for lost elven treasure. Before the search can begin, the professor needs your protection while he charges goggles for the dark sea. Professor Phizzlethorpe asks you to guard him as he prepares for a search beneath the dark sea. Doctor Draxlegauge built goggles to find the lost gems, but they need power from an enchanted stone in a cave a short way uphill. The cave is cursed, and those who draw near are ambushed. Defend the professor while he draws the stone’s energy into the goggles.

quest:666.text: Sunken Treasure. In Faldir's Cove, Doctor Draxlegauge lends you his goggles to find ten elven gems for Captain O'Breen. He expects them back when you finish. The elven gems have lain on the sea floor so long that thick stone has hardened around them. The Goggles of Gem Hunting hold the power to find them through those stony shells. Proud of the gnomish ingenuity behind the goggles, Doctor Draxlegauge lends them to you. The gems are for Captain O'Breen. Doctor Draxlegauge says scientific work keeps him on safe, dry land, though he could swim down himself. He expects you to return the goggles afterward. Captain O'Breen, he says, will have plenty of use for them.

quest:667.text: Death From Below. Aboard Shakes O'Breen's ship in the Arathi Highlands, the Daggerspine naga gather to strike. You stand with O'Breen, man the cannon, and help the crew sail back to Booty Bay. After the Sunken Treasure, Shakes O'Breen sees the Daggerspine naga gathering to attack. They are ruthless and will keep coming until O'Breen is dead. O'Breen puts the crew's safety ahead of their own and asks you to defend them. Without O'Breen's knowledge of the seas, the crew cannot reach Booty Bay. So you wait aboard with O'Breen for the naga to rise from the water.

quest:668.text: Sunken Treasure. Doctor Draxlegauge sends you to Captain O'Breen, who waits at the bridge for the elven gems. After weeks among pirates, the doctor and the professor have learned that keeping pirate treasure is bad for their health. Doctor Draxlegauge is eager to bring Captain O'Breen the elven gems. The captain waits at the bridge and wants to see them for himself. After weeks among these pirates, the doctor and the professor have learned that keeping pirate treasure is bad for their health. So Draxlegauge gives you the gems to carry to O'Breen.

quest:669.text: Sunken Treasure. In Sunken Treasure, Shakes O'Breen is held back by the low tide and watchful creatures, so word must reach Booty Bay. Shakes O'Breen needs Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay to hear of the find at once. The tide is too low for him to leave, and the creatures his crew disturbed watch every move. He asks you to tell Seahorn the treasure has been found and more is being brought up. You carry a sample elven gem as proof.

quest:670.text: Sunken Treasure. Fleet Master Seahorn waits in Booty Bay with a letter for Shakes O'Breen off the Arathi coast. His ships cannot sail until they restock. Fleet Master Seahorn sees an adventurer in you. His ships must restock before they can leave Booty Bay. Heavy things are brewing here and abroad, he says, and he has a secret letter for Shakes O'Breen off the Arathi coast. Can he trust you to deliver it safely and keep it confidential?

quest:671.text: Foul Magics. In the Arathi Highlands, Tor'gan follows a demonic presence to Northfold Manor. From Hammerfall, he seeks help recovering bloodstone amulets from the summoners. Demonic energy stirs in the Arathi Highlands, and Tor'gan feels it from his post at Hammerfall. The pull draws the orc west toward Northfold Manor. There, he finds signs of demonic summoning, but the lingering corruption makes his blood boil and stirs an involuntary rage tied to the blood curse's history. He retreats before the influence overwhelms his senses, then seeks help from others. At Northfold Manor, Tor'gan found a bloodstone amulet on the ground. It showed that dark rituals were being performed there. Such charms help channel and steady demonic summonings, but the amulet he recovered had lost its magic. It held too little power for a thorough study. Tor'gan asks Horde travelers to retrieve ten intact amulets from the manor's practitioners, so he can examine the rituals and learn what entities were summoned.

quest:672.text: Raising Spirits. Tor'gan seeks a way to lift Gor'mul's spirits at Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. Tales of Orgrimmar and Warchief Thrall have brought no comfort, so Tor'gan turns to the Horde's newly rediscovered shamanic traditions. At Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands, Gor'mul has fallen into deep melancholy. His companions have told him of Kalimdor, the mighty city of Orgrimmar, and Warchief Thrall's leadership. Yet none of these tales has eased his gloom or given him hope. Tor'gan turns to the Horde's revived spiritual traditions to help Gor'mul. He gathers the eyes of highland raptors roaming Arathi and makes an amulet blessed with their spirits. Through this rite, he hopes the predators' vital force will awaken Gor'mul's will to live.

quest:673.text: Foul Magics. In Hammerfall, Tor'gan fears a warlock in Stromgarde is calling demons with an arcane relic. Your first work for him has led to a hunt for the warlock and the relic. Tor'gan is certain a warlock within Stromgarde's walls uses an arcane relic to call up terrible demons in great numbers. The burning in his blood grows by the day. So he sends you to find and kill the warlock, then bring back the magical object on the warlock's body. He means to destroy it before its power can taint the land. The warlock is Marez Cowl, and the object is a Befouled Bloodstone Orb.

quest:674.text: Raising Spirits. A Horde emissary hopes Raising Spirits will help Gor'mul find his fighting spirit again. The Raptor Talon Amulet is meant to rekindle it, but Gor'mul remains bitter and doubts any trinket can restore the Horde's former glory. An emissary brings Gor'mul a Raptor Talon Amulet, hoping its power will reach him. The talisman channels the wild strength and ferocity of raptors. It is meant to rekindle the flame that once burned fiercely within the orc warrior.

quest:675.text: Raising Spirits. Tor'gan hopes ancestral magic can restore Gor'mul's pride and will to live. The shaman seeks to lift an old orc veteran from despair. Gor'mul grieves that he survived when his fallen Warchief did not. Many orc veterans bear the weight of past wars, but Gor'mul believes fate denied him an honorable death beside his leader. Tor'gan, a shaman, hopes to ease that sorrow by recalling his people's spiritual strength. He prepares an enchanted amulet and trusts ancestral power to rekindle the old warrior's pride.

quest:676.text: The Hammer May Fall. Tallow sends fighters from Tarren Mill through the mountains to relieve Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. Before reporting to Drum Fel, you prove your strength against Boulderfist ogres near the ruins of Stromgarde. In Tarren Mill, Tallow has little patience for fighters who have not proved themselves. While recruits stand idle, allies face attack far away. He sends capable fighters east through Thoradin's Wall into the Arathi Highlands, where Hammerfall is besieged from several sides. First, they must prove their worth against a strong foe. Only then will Tallow send them to the outpost. Tallow demands a show of strength at the ogre mound northeast of the ruins of Stromgarde. Boulderfist ogres and their enforcers hold much of Arathi and threaten travelers on the highland trails. Fighting them thins the hostile forces flanking the road. It also proves you can face the danger before reaching Hammerfall.

quest:677.text: Call to Arms. Drum Fel calls the Horde to strike from Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. The Witherbark have joined the Boulderfist ogres, and the Horde means to hold its foothold there. At Hammerfall, Drum Fel rallies the Horde from its fortified outpost in the Arathi Highlands. Old human ruins and hostile powers surround the settlement. The Witherbark forest trolls and Boulderfist ogres have made a pact, putting the Horde's foothold at risk. Drum Fel calls on champions to strike first and keep their enemies from deciding the struggle's course. South of Hammerfall, the Horde's first strikes reach Witherbark territory. The forest trolls have rejected diplomacy and joined the Boulderfist ogres in trying to drive the Horde from the highlands. Hammerfall targets their axe throwers, headhunters and witch doctors to weaken their leaders and show that the Horde intends to stay.

quest:678.text: Call to Arms. At Hammerfall, Drum Fel sends proven warriors against the Boulderfist ogres. Their attacks threaten the Horde's foothold in Arathi. At Hammerfall, Drum Fel calls on travelers who have aided the outpost to face a real threat. Boulderfist ogres have harassed the Horde expedition and tested its defenders. Fel sends warriors against these foes, not minor skirmishers. He expects them to return alive or with honor, and promises praise for their tenacity in battle. Southwest of Hammerfall, the Boulderfist clan has dug in near the dwarven bridge between Arathi and the Wetlands. Brutes fight alongside cunning magi, bringing crushing strength and deadly magic. Their aggression threatens Horde supply lines and control of the region. Drum Fel orders warriors to defeat ten Boulderfist brutes and four magi. Their defeat will weaken the clan and show that Hammerfall will not yield ground or tolerate rivals in Arathi.

quest:679.text: Call to Arms. At Hammerfall, Drum Fel sends you after the Boulderfist leaders in Stromgarde. After your earlier work, he says it is time to strike the head from the beast. Drum Fel says you are ready to help deliver one last great blow. The Boulderfist leaders have made their lair in Stromgarde’s ruins, which he calls a symbol of human frailty. He sends you to hunt down the lords and the shaman who serve them. They lead attacks meant to drive the Horde from these lands.

quest:680.text: The Real Threat. Korin Fel asks you to end the attacks on Hammerfall by slaying Or'Kalar and bringing her his head. Korin Fel says you serve her husband well, though he does not know why Hammerfall is under attack. Or'Kalar serves Mug'thol in Stromgarde and seeks her husband's death. Years ago, her husband defeated the ogre. Now Korin's auguries warn that Or'Kalar has set a trap for him. Korin has hidden the signs of Or'Kalar's presence from her husband. She fears he would rush off foolishly if he knew where the ogre was, so she asks you to help instead. Or'Kalar is near the Tower of Arathor. Korin expects his death to end the attacks on Hammerfall.

quest:682.text: Stromgarde Badges. In Stromgarde, the Syndicate pays for militia badges taken from the fallen. At Refuge Pointe, Captain Nials wants them brought back. The Syndicate fights a contingent of militia in Stromgarde. Its leaders offer gold for every badge taken from a slain militiaman, hoping to turn their followers against the better-trained soldiers. Captain Nials calls the Syndicate cutthroats and refuses to let them keep trophies from the brave fallen. You enter the part of Stromgarde they hold and bring the badges back to Refuge Pointe. Nials wants them to learn they cannot profit from the dead.

quest:684.text: WANTED: Marez Cowl. At Stromgarde, Marez Cowl advises Syndicate leaders and traffics with demons. Her influence threatens Alliance forces in the Arathi Highlands. At Refuge Pointe, Alliance commanders offer a bounty on a high-ranking Syndicate leader. Marez Cowl advises the Syndicate and directs its work in Stromgarde’s ruins as a field operative. The bounty aims to break the group’s local command. Marez Cowl is a warlock among the Syndicate’s brigands and dispossessed nobles. She deals openly with demonic powers to enforce her will and defend Syndicate territory. To reach her lair in Stromgarde, you must face armed criminals and the demons she commands.

quest:685.text: WANTED: Otto and Falconcrest. In the Arathi Highlands, the Stromgarde Militia has marked Lord Falconcrest and Otto for death. Falconcrest leads the local Syndicate forces, and Otto guards him with deadly skill. Their deaths would weaken the Syndicate's hold in the region. Proof must reach Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe. From Refuge Pointe, Stromgarde's defenders seek to break the Syndicate's hold over their ancestral lands. The militia has placed a bounty on Lord Falconcrest and Otto, his bodyguard. Bring both targets' heads to Captain Nials to claim the reward. Lord Falconcrest directs the Syndicate's push into the Arathi Highlands. His death would disrupt the criminal network's work in the region. Otto is a brutally effective bodyguard. His blades have killed dozens of Stromgarde's remaining militia soldiers.

quest:687.text: Theldurin the Lost. In the Badlands, the Twilight's Hammer hunts for Theldurin the Lost and the scroll of Myzrael he took when he fled. Theldurin once followed the Twilight's Hammer. Then his mind slipped, and he turned from its teachings. He fled with the scroll of Myzrael, and the order could not catch him. Word has reached the Twilight's Hammer that Theldurin hides in the Badlands, raving and mad. The order needs the scroll for the Lady's return. First, you must find the man who took it.

quest:688.text: Myzrael's Allies. Through the keystone, Myzrael declares herself free, though still hidden from her captors. She sends you to Zaruk in Hammerfall, who knows how to summon her. Myzrael declares that she is free through the keystone. She must gather her strength out of sight. Her captors would overpower and imprison her again if they faced her now. In time, she vows to confront the giants who held her and make them regret keeping her. Myzrael calls you a noble ally and says she will need your aid again in time. When ready, she will have you summon her to the surface. For now, she sends you to Zaruk in Hammerfall, who knows how it can be done.

quest:690.text: Malin's Request. In Stormwind, Archmage Malin asks for help recovering relics from fallen Stromgarde. He sends seasoned Alliance adventurers north to Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands, where an expedition seeks the magical relics left behind when Stromgarde fell. Archmage Malin serves in Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum and acts for his former mentor, Archmage Trelane. When Stromgarde fell into chaos, Trelane made a desperate stand at the Tower of Arathor. As hostile forces took the city, he had to abandon his post and leave powerful enchanted possessions behind. Malin fears those relics may fall into hostile hands. He sends capable mercenaries north to strengthen his agents in the field and reclaim Trelane's lost belongings. Refuge Pointe lies on the road to Trelane's relics, in the central Arathi Highlands. The outpost is a hard-pressed refuge for Stromgarde loyalists, and Malin's chief contact there is the dwarf Skuerto. Syndicate outlaws, Witherbark trolls, and Boulderfist ogres press the outpost from every side. When you arrive, Skuerto and the garrison are stretched too thin to welcome you warmly without immediate help.

quest:691.text: Worth Its Weight in Gold. At Refuge Pointe, Apprentice Kryten needs reagents for Archmage Malin. He asks you to gather tusks, medicine pouches and a shadow hunter's knife from the Witherbark trolls of southeastern Arathi. Archmage Malin sent Kryten and Skuerto to Arathi for reagents. Kryten was unsure how to gather them until you arrived. He needs ten Witherbark tusks, four medicine pouches and one shadow hunter knife. The Witherbark trolls live in southeastern Arathi. Kryten's research says every Witherbark troll should have tusks. The witch doctors carry medicine pouches. The knife belongs to the mightiest shadow hunters, who receive it after completing their rites of passage. Only battle will show which one carries it.

quest:692.text: The Lost Fragments. Behind Theldurin, furious elementals fight over scraps of the Scroll of Myzrael. You gather the torn pieces while he fears what its magic might do. Theldurin the Lost fears the Scroll of Myzrael could draw Myzrael up to the surface. Then he considers another danger. She may already be free, or gathering strength to strike. If so, the scroll may be what you need to bind her again. Furious elementals took the scroll and tore it apart. Now they fight over its scraps in the hills behind Theldurin. Bring back three pieces: one torn, one crumpled and one singed. Theldurin hopes to mend them.

quest:693.text: Wand over Fist. At Refuge Pointe, Skuerto has found where Trelane's first item went. Kor'gresh holds Trelane's Wand of Invocation in Boulderfist Hall, and Skuerto wants it back. After your work for Apprentice Kryten, Skuerto has traced Trelane's first item to Kor'gresh. The ogre holds the wand in Boulderfist Hall and uses blasts of ice to keep his kin in line. Skuerto fears Kor'gresh is close to discovering all its powers. Boulderfist Hall lies south of Refuge Pointe, then east of Thandol Span.

quest:694.text: Trelane's Defenses. Ogres now ring the Tower of Arathor, and Skuerto needs its defenses working. An azure agate from the Boulderfist shaman can become a key after Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe enchants it. In Stromgarde, ogres ring the Tower of Arathor. Skuerto says you need to activate its defenses to have a chance against them. Only then can you reach the items alive. The Boulderfist shaman took certain gems from the tower and have grown fond of them. Skuerto says they will not keep the gems for long. Bring an azure agate to Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe. Kryten knows the spell that will enchant it to work as a key.

quest:695.text: An Apprentice's Enchantment. At the camp, Apprentice Kryten enchants the agate you brought from the Boulderfist shaman. It can wake the tower's defenses, and Kryten sends you to Skuerto before you leave. Apprentice Kryten gives you the enchanted gem and explains its power. Touch it to a pedestal at the tower's foot, and its defenses will wake. When you are ready to enter and search for the rest of Trelane's items, use the gem. Kryten will wait for you at the camp. Before you go, speak with Skuerto, who can answer any other questions.

quest:696.text: Attack on the Tower. At Refuge Pointe, Skuerto sends you to search the ogre-held tower for three items tied to Trelane. The phylactery, orb and ember agate should be in chests inside, and Skuerto says Malin will be pleased when you return with them. After Kryten enchants the gem, Skuerto sends you to find Trelane's phylactery, orb and ember agate. The three items should be in chests inside the tower, ready for you to open. But the ogres are dangerous. The tower's defenses will not deal with them, and the ogres will hurt you if they catch you stealing.

quest:697.text: Malin's Request. In Stormwind, Skuerto's letter carries news from Arathi to Archmage Malin. You are sent to the Mage Quarter with word that Kryten and Skuerto will soon be home. After your work in Arathi, Skuerto gives you a sealed letter for Archmage Malin in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. It says Kryten and Skuerto will be home soon. Skuerto trusts Malin will repay you well for helping them and wishes you a safe journey.

quest:698.text: Lack of Surplus. Dar needs more sawtooth meat for the eastern beach outpost. Tok'Kar has little time between guard shifts and cooking for the soldiers, so Dar asks you to bring some. Dar is gathering supplies for the outpost on the eastern beach. Tok'Kar guards the post and cooks for its soldiers, leaving little time for other work. The soldiers enjoy sawtooth meat when they can get it. Dar has not had time to send another shipment. Older sawtooths taste better, Dar says, so leave the young ones alone. They need a year or two to reach full size. Bring eight unprepared sawtooth flanks to Tok'Kar in the Swamp of Sorrows.

quest:699.text: Lack of Surplus. Along the coast, Tok'Kar and his soldiers watch for murlocs threatening Stonard. When the force grows too large, they send warning; for now, Tok'Kar asks you to bring six sawtooth snapper claws. Tok'Kar and the soldiers guard Stonard from murlocs along the coast. When the force is too large to face, they warn the town. Tok'Kar has little time to rest, so he asks you to help. Properly prepared, sawtooth snapper claws make fine weapons. Bring him six, and he offers one of the outpost's weapons in return, grateful for the meat and company.

quest:7003.text:
Zapped Giants. On Feralas's Forgotten Coast, Zorbin Fandazzle tests a shrinking ray on the giants near the docks. He built it from a gnomish design and improved it with goblin know-how, then gives you the Ultra-Shrinker to try on Feralas's giants. Zorbin Fandazzle needs the giants of Feralas dealt with so he can stay and keep his business. His answer is a shrinking ray based on a gnomish design, improved with what he calls superior goblin advances. He would rather you test it than risk his own life.

Use the Ultra-Shrinker on Cliff Giants, Deep Striders, Wave Striders, Shore Striders or Land Walkers. Gather the miniaturization residue left behind when they shrink, then bring it back to the docks. Zorbin calls miniaturization residue valuable in engineering. It helps keep a zapper from exploding on its user. Then he adds that this applies only to other zappers, not the one in your hands.

quest:701.text: Guile of the Raptor. Tor'gan seeks to awaken Gor'mul's dormant warrior spirit through the guile of the raptor. He gathers Highland Fleshstalker hearts to make an enchanted charm and restore Gor'mul's fighting resolve. Tor'gan wants to draw Gor'mul out of his listlessness and restore the warrior spirit that lies dormant. He turns to primal magic instead of persuasion, hoping a charm filled with wild predators' essence will stir Gor'mul to action. Through the charm, he seeks to renew Gor'mul's martial resolve and show him the strength of this power. Tor'gan needs Highland Fleshstalker hearts to call on the instincts of a cunning hunter. In shamanic and primal traditions, a predator's heart carries its ferocity and guile. Tor'gan uses these trophies to make a physical token and weave a spell. He hopes they will give Gor'mul a predator's cunning and help him rediscover his calling.

quest:702.text:
Guile of the Raptor. At Hammerfall, Tor'gan sends you to Gor'mul with an orb to rouse the warrior's spirit. Its energy bears the raptor's essence and may give Gor'mul fresh purpose. Tor'gan gives you an orb meant to fill Gor'mul with the raptor's essence. He hopes it will rouse the warrior's spirit and set him on a fresh course in life.

Once Gor'mul is himself again, Tor'gan plans to explain the Horde's present state. He hopes to win the help of a great warrior in its unceasing battles. Gor'mul greets your return with bitterness. He says all he wants is more of Tor'gan's pity, then mocks you with talk of brightly colored string.

quest:703.text: Barbecued Buzzard Wings. Rigglefuzz has every ingredient for his barbecued buzzard wings except the wings themselves. Rigglefuzz takes pride in his barbecued buzzard wings. He coats the tangy meat in rich sauce, and its aroma carries to hungry folk nearby. He has all the ingredients for a batch but the wings. Bring him four buzzard wings, and he may share the recipe.

quest:705.text: Pearl Diving. In the Badlands, Rigglefuzz is running low on powder for his flash bombs. He sends you to the Vile Reef in Stranglethorn to gather more. Rigglefuzz admits the Badlands frighten him. A short little goblin, he faces predators and scavengers all around. He knows how to make flash bombs, and uses them to drive the wildlife away. Now he is running low on crushed blue pearl powder. Clams at the Vile Reef in Stranglethorn hold blue pearls. Rigglefuzz jokes that you had better wear good boots, then waits in the Badlands for nine pearls. He promises to make your effort worthwhile.

quest:706.text: Fiery Blaze Enchantments. A rare black drake whelp's still-beating heart is needed for Fiery Blaze Enchantments in the Badlands. Sigrun Ironhew waits for word from Ironforge, and the whelps of Lethlor Ravine may supply what she needs. Sigrun Ironhew learned to kindle fire on weapons while apprenticed to Feranor Steeltoe. Feranor was last heard of among the smiths of a hunting party in Lordaeron. Sigrun waits in the Badlands for word from Ironforge. She has little else to do. Sigrun shares little about the process. It calls for blood from the still-beating heart of a rare black drake whelp. Bring her a heart from a whelp in Lethlor Ravine, and she will show you the skill. The Scalding Whelps and Scorched Guardians there yield the hearts.

quest:708.text: The Black Box. A giant condor in the Badlands swallowed a black box marked for Ironforge. After ages in the condor's stomach, acid had pitted the metal. A symbol marks the underside above the words Engine #19 - Ironforge Siege Brigade. You carry the box to Pilot Longbeard in Ironforge's Hall of Arms.

quest:710.text: Study of the Elements: Rock. In the Badlands, Lotwil Veriatus needs stone shards to test his work on elemental shackles. Lesser rock elementals roam the hills just west of him. In the Badlands, Lotwil Veriatus is making shackles of elemental binding. When finished, they will let mages summon stronger elementals for greater uses. To test his offensive spells and a few pieced-together gizmos, he needs ten small stone shards. Lesser rock elementals roam the hills immediately west.

quest:711.text:
Study of the Elements: Rock. Lotwil Veriatus is ready to test larger pieces after the small shards behaved as he expected. He needs three large stone slabs from rock elementals. Lotwil Veriatus needs sturdier pieces for his next tests. Rock elementals have larger bodies, so their remains may yield slabs big enough.

He points you farther west or southeast along the mountain edges to gather three large stone slabs. For now, Lotwil needs time to test the smaller pieces you brought. Lotwil's spells acted on the smaller pieces as he predicted. If the next experiment goes as he expects, the elementals he controls will outshine anything he has summoned before.

quest:712.text:
Study of the Elements: Rock. In the Badlands, Lotwil Veriatus needs bracers from greater rock elementals to judge his shackles. Lotwil Veriatus needs one last part from the Badlands' elementals, after the stone slabs. Bracers of rock binding from greater rock elementals will help him judge the shackles under construction.

His scrying found a group southwest, near some ogres, if memory serves. He asks for five bracers so there will be spares, since Servo often misplaces reagents and research.

quest:713.text: Coolant Heads Prevail. Lotwil Veriatus needs Frost Oil for the shackles holding his summoned friend. Bro'kin, Lotwil's goblin friend in Alterac, can teach you to make it. Lotwil Veriatus says Frost Oil keeps engines and gears from overheating. He calls it an unmatched lubricant. It also helps magical items hold their enchantments. The oil could strengthen Lotwil's shackles enough to stop his summoned friend from killing everyone. Bro'kin, Lotwil's goblin friend, can teach you to make Frost Oil. He sells from a spot on the old city's wall in the Ruins of Alterac.

quest:714.text:
Gyro... What?. In the Badlands, Lotwil Veriatus is still at work on his contraption. You have brought him the Frost Oil from Coolant Heads Prevail, but one small part is missing: a gyrochronatom. Lotwil Veriatus is so caught up in his work that he praises you for doing the job beyond all standards. Then he says you may apply for work if you meet him in Kharanos.

A hurried scramble follows as Lotwil tries to catch hold of something. Then he asks for a gyrochronatom. The part is small but crucial, and with it the project should be ready to complete.

quest:716.text: Stone Is Better than Cloth. In the Badlands, Lucien Tosselwrench has a gift for you, though his work is not finished. The extra stones you gathered are ready, but he still needs patterned bronze bracers. After your work for Lotwil on his third Study of the Elements: Rock request, Lucien Tosselwrench admits Lotwil can be cheap. He means to make it up to you with fine enchanted bracers fashioned from the extra stones you gathered. They may help guard you against the coming atrocity of Lotwil's newest invention. To finish the bracers, Lucien needs patterned bronze bracers of the kind a blacksmith makes. He warns you not to wait long. No one knows what happens next.

quest:7162.text: Proving Grounds. In Alterac, recruits face a trial before they may join the Stormpike Guard. Lieutenant Haggerdin sends them into Icewing Caverns for a planted battle standard. Success earns an official Stormpike Insignia and opens the way through the expedition’s ranks. The Stormpike Guard fights the Frostwolf Clan in Alterac Valley. Lieutenant Haggerdin directs Alliance forces from their encampment in the Alterac Mountains. Before recruits reach the battlefield, he tests their skill and nerve in Icewing Caverns southwest of Dun Baldar. Deep in Icewing Caverns, a Stormpike banner waits among the frozen tunnels. Frost harpies nest in the icy recesses and attack unwary trespassers. A recruit who brings the banner back intact has crossed dangerous ground, faced its predators, and kept discipline under pressure. Return from the caverns with the standard, and you earn a Stormpike initiate’s insignia and a place in the expeditionary force. Haggerdin says the insignia can improve as you earn greater honor on the battlefield. The Eye of Command is one distant aim.

quest:717.text: Tremors of the Earth. At Lethlor, Garek fears the drakes may break free. Black dragons now dwell there, and ogres have taken the Sign of the Earth. So he sends you to free the drakes and kill them. At Lethlor, Garek fears Blacklash and Hematus may escape their prison. Black dragons now dwell there, and ogres have taken the Sign of the Earth. Garek sees no safer course. The drakes must die. Three runestones hold the drakes, and the Sign of the Earth is needed to release them. You use the Sign at the Pillars of Amethyst, Opal and Diamond, then place the runestones in the Seal of the Earth. Blacklash and Hematus are freed, and you slay them. Garek asks you to bring back Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus and the Sign of the Earth.

quest:718.text: Mirages. In the Badlands, Sigrun Ironhew's party has fled the Uldaman excavation and gone hungry. Sigrun's party fled the Uldaman dig in such haste that they took little with them. They left wagons and supply crates behind, and ogres from Camp Kosh have been picking through them. The ogres took the cart with all the party's weapons. Since then, the party has had no food. Sigrun admits the trouble is embarrassing and asks you to retrieve the supply crate.

quest:719.text: A Dwarf and His Tools. Prospector Ryedol escaped an attack on his dig site and now seeks his lucky pick. Dark Iron dwarves resembling the Shadowforge clan are all around. Dark Iron dwarves resembling the Shadowforge clan attacked the excavation site where Ryedol worked. Nearly everyone died, including his boss, Hammertoe. Ryedol barely escaped with his life. The site lies north of where he waits. Prospector Ryedol is trying to recover supplies lost in the attack, especially his lucky pick. One of the Dark Iron dwarves has it, though Ryedol does not know which one. He hopes you will help and waits south of Hammertoe's Dig Site.

quest:720.text: A Sign of Hope. Hammertoe Grez lives, and a chalk plea on a crumpled map calls Prospector Ryedol to help. The note says they are taking Hammertoe to Uldaman. Hammertoe leaves a brief plea for Ryedol in chalk on a crumpled map. The note says they are taking Hammertoe to Uldaman and asks for help. Tell Prospector Ryedol that Hammertoe Grez lives.

quest:723.text: Prospect of Faith. In the Badlands, Hammertoe Grez sends you to Prospector Ryedol with his amulet. Ryedol knows Hammertoe sought the origins of their people and wants to keep the scrolls from the Shadowforge clan. Wounded in the Badlands, Hammertoe Grez asks you to carry his amulet to Ryedol. He trusts Ryedol to know what to do. Hammertoe sought the origins of their people and meant to thwart the Shadowforge clan. The clan must not get the scrolls.

quest:724.text: Prospect of Faith. In the Badlands, Prospector Ryedol sends you to Ironforge with Hammertoe's Amulet. Historian Karnik and Hammertoe sought Uldaman's lost artifacts together. Ryedol suspects the Shadowforge learned they knew more than they let on. Prospector Ryedol sends you to Historian Karnik in Ironforge. Tell Karnik what happened to Hammertoe and place the amulet in his hands. Karnik will decide what to do next.

quest:725.text:
Passing Word of a Threat. Karnik sends you to Advisor Belgrum with a sealed note. Tell Belgrum what you witnessed and ask how to proceed while Karnik seeks answers from Hammertoe's spirit. Historian Karnik needs you to reach Advisor Belgrum quickly. Tell him what you witnessed and ask how he wants to proceed. The sealed note explains more.

Meanwhile, Karnik speaks with Hammertoe's spirit, hoping to learn how to end the Shadowforge's doings in the Badlands. He can only pray that Hammertoe knows something that will help.

quest:726.text: Passing Word of a Threat. In the Badlands, Belgrum sends you back to Karnik with the king's command to act swiftly against the Shadowforge. Belgrum reads Karnik's note to the end. His eyes widen at the evil tidings. He sends you back to Karnik with the king's command: act swiftly and decisively on what is known. The Shadowforge's activities in the Badlands must stop.

quest:727.text: To Ironforge for Yagyin's Digest. Theldurin the Lost sends you to Ironforge with a sigil. In a shop in the Forlorn Cavern, Gerrig Bonegrip is meant to take you for one of the people Theldurin fled, so you can ask him for Yagyin's Digest. The Tablet has taught Theldurin much, yet questions remain. Yagyin wrote a digest ages ago, and the people Theldurin fled keep copies in many places. Their most learned study it. Theldurin believes its vast knowledge can offer protection, so he wants you to bring it back. Gerrig Bonegrip keeps a shop in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern. Theldurin gives you the Sigil of the Hammer to show Gerrig. Then Gerrig should take you for one of the people Theldurin fled. Ask him for Yagyin's Digest.

quest:728.text: To the Undercity for Yagyin's Digest. Theldurin the Lost sends you to the Undercity of Lordaeron with a sigil for Keeper Bel'dugur. He wants the keeper to mistake you for one of the people he fled, and asks you to find Yagyin's Digest. The tablet has answered much for Theldurin, yet questions remain. Yagyin wrote a digest ages ago, and the people Theldurin fled keep copies in many places. Their most learned study its pages. Theldurin believes its vast knowledge can protect them, so he wants you to bring it back. Keeper Bel'dugur waits in the Undercity of Lordaeron. Theldurin gives you the Sigil of the Hammer to show the keeper, who is to take you for one of the people he fled. Ask Bel'dugur for the digest.

quest:732.text: Tremors of the Earth. Garek asks for your help after hearing all you have done for Sigrun. His master, Krasus of the Kirin Tor, sent him to the Badlands to stop trouble brewing in Lethlor Ravine. First, he needs the stolen Sign of the Earth. Krasus of the Kirin Tor sent Garek to the Badlands to stop trouble brewing in Lethlor Ravine. He cannot tell you the exact assignment, only that it matters greatly. Roving ogres took the Sign of the Earth, and Garek needs it back before he can tell you more. They are sometimes seen around Camp Boff. Ogres wander from camp to camp across the Badlands. Rising heat and swirling winds make their trail hard to follow. Garek has heard they sometimes pass through Camp Boff, so look there if you lose track of them.

quest:733.text: Scrounging. At Sigrun Ironhew's camp, defenses and supplies wait on scrap metal. She needs seven pieces, and nearby ogres carry plenty. Sigrun Ironhew needs materials for the camp's defenses and other needs. The Prospector worries about the camp's condition, so Sigrun wants to begin work soon. Scrap metal is what she lacks. Nearby ogres carry scrap metal, adding weight to talk of siege engines in the Badlands. Their main camp, Dustbelch Grotto, lies a long trek west of Sigrun's camp.

quest:734.text: This Is Going to Be Hard. In the Badlands, Lotwil Veriatus sends you to Lucien Tosselwrench for a needed cog #5. Bring it back to Lotwil. Lotwil Veriatus turns his attention to the shackles, then sends you to Lucien Tosselwrench. He needs a cog #5 and asks you to bring it back to him.

quest:735.text: The Star, the Hand and the Heart. In Ironforge, Gerrig Bonegrip offers Yagyin's Digest in exchange for three items of power. Their names are kept from listening ears and written in a note. Gerrig Bonegrip hears you ask for Yagyin's Digest and wonders whether you mean to begin a new chapter of the order somewhere. Gerrig decides it is not their place to ask. With an extra copy on hand, Gerrig believes those of the order should aid one another. So Gerrig asks you to bring three items of power. Their names stay unspoken in case someone is listening, and Gerrig writes them down. Gerrig's note names the Star of Xil'yeh, the Hand of Dagun and the Legacy Heart. Gerrig wants all three before handing over Yagyin's Digest.

quest:736.text: The Star, the Hand and the Heart. In the Undercity, Keeper Bel'dugur tests those who seek to lead their own circle. To found a new chapter, they need Yagyin's Digest, but he asks for three unnamed items of power. Practitioners who hope to lead their own circle come to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity. To found a chapter and gather followers, they need Yagyin's Digest, a work of ritual lore in his keeping. Bel'dugur will aid a brother, but first he asks for proof of worthiness before entrusting him with such knowledge. Keeper Bel'dugur asks for three items of power in exchange for Yagyin's Digest. Their names carry peril or sacred weight, so he will not speak them aloud. Instead, he writes them on a private note. Finding all three proves a practitioner worthy of founding a chapter of their own.

quest:737.text: Forbidden Knowledge. Yagyin's Digest is in your care, bound for Theldurin the Lost and kept from unfriendly hands. Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge or Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity gives you Yagyin's Digest. Keep it from unfriendly hands as you carry it to Theldurin the Lost. It holds many truths, and truth has a way of burning.

quest:738.text: Find Agmond. Weeks have passed without word from Prospector Agmond at the Badlands digs. Prospector Ironband now needs you to find Agmond and bring back his report. Prospector Agmond oversaw the Badlands excavations southwest of Ironband. Ironband calls him a prospector no longer, for weeks have passed without word. He needs you to find Agmond and recover the report. Agmond was last heard from at the southernmost dig, a small outfit beyond Angor Fortress. Begin there.

quest:739.text: Murdaloc. Agmond lies dead in the Badlands, with Murdaloc scratched into the sandstone beside his hand. Slay his killer and carry word to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan. Blood marks Agmond's trail from the west, crossing stone and sand. It shows how far the dwarf crawled before he died. Beside his still hand, one word is scratched into the Badlands sandstone: Murdaloc. Slay Agmond's killer and a number of Stonevault Bonesnappers, then carry the news to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan.

quest:7541.text: Service to the Horde. In Orgrimmar, Zor Lonetree has received the jeweled pendant and has more to tell you about your service to the Horde. The jeweled pendant now rests with Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar. Return to him to hear more about your service to the Horde.

quest:762.text: An Ambassador of Evil. In the Badlands, Historian Karnik sends you after Ambassador Infernus. He wants you to carry proof of the kill to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge. Ragnaros sent Ambassador Infernus to Angor Fortress to oversee the Shadowforge's hunt for lost artifacts in Uldaman. The search has already cost many dwarven lives, and more are dying. Karnik fears the Shadowforge could turn the artifacts against Ironforge. So he sends you back into the Badlands to destroy Infernus and carry Belgrum proof of your victory. Time is short. Ragnaros will not wait for the Shadowforge to prepare.

quest:77.text: A Sticky Situation. Dran Droffers seeks the original packaging for Hinterlands Honey Ripple. Gilveradin Sunchaser has it and asks for two extra bottles; ten bottles wait in crates around the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock.
